stories.title: Trump threatens to wipe out Iran as Tehran warns of 'painful' response
stories.summary: Trump said Iran must strike a deal or face economic collapse or the removal of its leadership, while Iran's military warned of sustained retaliation against U.S. and allied interests across the region. The exchange escalates tensions as Iranian officials head to the UN General Assembly in New York this week.

stories.title: BBC finds jailed teacher convicted of sexual abuse secretly released early in Indonesia
stories.summary: An investigative BBC report found that a teacher jailed for sexual abuse was quietly released early in Indonesia. The case raises fresh questions about prison-release practices and accountability for sex-abuse convictions.

stories.title: US and China discuss AI safety plan ahead of Trump-Xi summit
stories.summary: Washington and Beijing are in talks on a joint AI safety framework ahead of the Trump-Xi summit. The move signals both governments seeking guardrails around frontier AI even as they compete on deployment.

stories.title: Nvidia boss rejects AI extinction fears as 'doomsday narratives'
stories.summary: Nvidia's chief executive dismissed warnings that advanced AI could end human existence, calling them doomsday narratives. The remarks push back on the safety concerns raised by some leading AI researchers.

stories.title: Browns' defense shows resilience in 23-19 win over Buccaneers
stories.summary: Cleveland's defense held Tampa Bay scoreless after halftime and stopped a late drive to seal a 23-19 win, the Browns' first of the season. Deshaun Watson led three second-half scoring drives, including two touchdowns, after a slow, penalty-heavy start.

stories.title: Ugo Ugochukwu reflects on dramatic Formula 3 title triumph
stories.summary: American Ugo Ugochukwu clinched the F3 drivers' title in the season finale in Madrid after starting level on points with rival Freddie Slater, capping a comeback from a double-digit deficit. He reflected on the win a week after securing the championship.

stories.title: Flood recovery underway in Pickaway, Hocking counties after weekend flash flooding
stories.summary: First responders in Pickaway County worked through Sunday to help residents hit by flash floods after heavy rain, with a flood watch still in effect for parts of Ohio. Officials warned more rain was possible as recovery continued.

stories.title: Pickaway County restaurant deals with flooding during weekend storms
stories.summary: A restaurant near Laurelville was flooded during heavy weekend rain as storms pounded Pickaway and Hocking counties, part of the damage left by the region's flash flooding. The business was among those cleaning up in the aftermath.
